doc.keyword_cn_name: Chinese name of keyword; null if no translation.
doc.images: Image urls of top 10 products in search result for quick keyword recognition.
doc.rank_change_of_weekly: Rank change compared to last week, positive or negative.
doc.update: Latest ABA rank update date(yyyy-MM-dd). (Return format is yyyyMMdd)
doc.share_click_rate: Click share ratio of top3 products.
doc.share_conversion_rate: Conversion share ratio of top3 products.
doc.top3_asin: Top3 ASIN with most click share, comma separated string. (String Array, each element format `ASIN,click share,conversion share`)
doc.top3_brand: Top3 brand list with highest click volume.
doc.top3_category: Top3 category name list with highest click volume.
doc.peak_season: Peak season months, null if no obvious peak season.
doc.search_result_first_page_stats: Structured first page report object, contains product count, organic/ad slots, review ratio, rating and coupon/hijack stats.
doc.search_result_first_page_stats.product_c: Quantity of products on the first page.
doc.search_result_first_page_stats.organic_l: Proportion of low-review products in organic positions, format "20.00|20.00|25.00".
doc.search_result_first_page_stats.ad_low_re: Proportion of low-review products in ad positions, same format as above.
doc.search_result_first_page_stats.no_rating: Quantity of products without star ratings.
doc.search_result_of_fp_trend: Flat array of first page historical trend: month, avg rating, avg review count, avg price, no-rating count. (Null if no data)
doc.associated_with_category_detail: Array of associated category structured object with category name and node_id. (Two-dimensional array, each element has 18 columns: 1st column node_id, 2nd column category name, remaining 16 columns are numeric values; semantics of each remaining column are not annotated)
doc.search_volume_yearly: Flat array for yearly search volume (last 3 years).
doc.page_estimate_daily_sales: Flat array: estimated daily sales required to rank on page 1/2. (Includes three groups for page 1/2/3)
doc.page_estimate_ad_budget: Flat array: estimated daily ad budget, three groups for page 1/2/3. Values are in USD (main currency unit, not cents).
doc.pit_competition_of_fp: Front page slot competition array, each item: type,asin count,slot count,ratio. (Element format `Total slots/Organic slots/Ad slots,ASIN count,slot count,ratio`)
